common_cycle_audit.policy: exclude one common right-boundary cycle set using dwell plus the primary 10 ms margin, then reuse it at both cadences

reference_provenance.boundary_policy: only complete HS-to-HS cycles; the contact already active at t_start and the open contact at t_end are boundary-censored

interpretation_limits: A development PASS identifies only a candidate for later 1 ms and sealed holdout validation; it does not create or promote a profile.
The prosthetic-foot mesh is used only to preregister simple sphere positions and enforce proximity; the detector itself remains exactly two spheres.
The primary profile supplies only FSM load/contact evidence. Heel strike and toe off are generated only by the candidate heel and forefoot sensors.
No policy, rollout, reward, training, runtime default, FSM, detector profile, or sealed data is modified or evaluated.
objective: Test a minimal data-driven placement grid for exactly two virtual gait-event sensors. Keep F80 fixed, vary heel height H1/H2 and forefoot depth P30--P32, use the two spheres only for heel/toe guards, and use the frozen primary online-GRF profile only for FSM load/contact evidence.
